events.title: UK Lloyds House Prices Stagnate
events.description: UK house prices remained unchanged in September after falling for two straight months amid higher interest rate expectations, monthly data published by Lloyds Banking Group showed Wednesday. House prices were flat in September on a monthly basis, following a 0.3 percent fall in August and a 0.1 percent drop in July.

events.title: European Shares Likely To Open On Cautious Note Ahead Of Fed Minutes
events.description: European stocks are seen opening slightly lower on Wednesday as oil prices climbed and yields rebounded on fears Iran is stepping up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Indian Shares Drift Lower Ahead Of RBI Rate Decision
events.description: Indian shares opened lower on Wednesday after two days of gains amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is trimming early losses in mid-market moves on Wednesday in choppy trading, after alternating across the unchanged line, snapping a three-session winning streak, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling below 8,750 level, despite the positive cues from Wall Street, with weakness in iron ore miners and financial stocks partially offset by gains in gold and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Wednesday, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid persistent risks to Middle East energy flows after Iran increased the pace of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days as well as the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi forces in Yemen. Asian markets closed mostly higher on Tuesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Lower As Investors Await RBI Policy Outcome
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening lower on Wednesday after two days of gains amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Thai Stock Market
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked higher in four straight sessions, gathering more than 20 points or 1.4 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,575-point plateau and it may see additional support again on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading modestly lower on Wednesday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling well below the 70,500 level, with weakness in exporters and technology stocks partially offset by gains in index heavyweights.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Extend Winning Streak
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in three straight sessions, climbing almost 185 points or 2.8 percent in that span. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,190-point plateau and it's likely to open to the upside again on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Lower
events.description: Australian shares are trading modestly lower on Wednesday, snapping a three-session winning streak, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling to near the 8,700 level, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with weakness in iron ore miners and financial stocks partially offset by gains in gold miners and technology stocks.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Poised For Additional Strength
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, improving more than 300 points or 1.2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,280-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green again on Wednesday.

events.title: Taiwan Shares May Crack Resistance At 50,000 Points
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, climbing more than 2,150 points or 4.6 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 49,820-point plateau and it may see mild upside again on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Add To Its Winnings
events.description: The Singapore stock market has tracked higher in back-to-back trading days, collecting more than 65 points or 1.2 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,700-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Wednesday.
